Late frame: waveform graphic and on-screen subtitles emphasizing the knocking sounds matching the investigator's count.
Closing frame: creator on camera with a skeptical expression, asking viewers whether they think it was fraud, fear, or something else.

content.audio_transcript: Okay, quick Enfield recap. In the late seventies, a family in North London said something in the house was knocking, moving things, and answering people back. Investigators showed up, and the weird part was how often the knocking seemed to repeat on cue. Some people say it was all staged. Others say there was enough here to leave them unsettled. Either way, the audio from this case still sounds creepy.

metadata.sound_design: voiceover + low ominous drone + faint knocking accents
